rule: Incompatible shapes MUST NOT be silently accepted. Each row is either reject (fail-closed) or adapter_required (translate at a boundary, then re-validate the canonical document).

shapes.reason: Canonical freshness is FRESH|STALE|UNKNOWN|ERROR. Silent uppercasing is forbidden.

shapes.description: expired used as a freshness or error stand-in.
shapes.reason: expired is a Directive status, not a freshness value. Persistence 'expired' is not ERROR and requires an adapter before it can enter this ontology.

shapes.description: status encoded as withdrawn or inactive.
shapes.reason: Canonical Directive status is draft|active|superseded|revoked|expired. withdrawn and inactive are not in the closed set.

shapes.description: scope encoded as an object instead of a string.
shapes.reason: Canonical scope is a STRING: company|commercial|finance|clients|infrastructure|inbound|repo:<name>|client:<slug>|prefix:id. Object scopes must be adapted, never silently coerced.

shapes.description: external resource id is a bare UUID.
shapes.reason: Canonical external ids are cc:<type>:<id>. Persistence UUIDs must be adapted at a boundary; a raw UUID is not a Control Center resource id.
